Hach and YSI Figures for Paper

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)
library(ggcorrplot)
source("Code/Functions/CorrelationFunction.R")
options(scipen = 999)
# time series data
dfTS <- read_csv("Data/Clean/HachYSI/01_DataWrangling/05-HachYSI-Data-All.csv") %>%
  select(-pH_Hach) %>% #take out pH data from Hach
  rename(pH = `pH (YSI)`) %>% #rename pH data from YSI to just pH
  mutate(`Temperature (ºC)` = ifelse(Date >= "2021-01-01" & Date < "2022-01-02" & `Temperature (ºC)` > 25.5, NA, `Temperature (ºC)`))

# history plot 
# 1x3: Temp C, Salinity (PSU), pH; 2011-2024
plotHistory <- dfTS %>%
  # use Daily time interval
  filter(`Time Interval` == "Daily") %>%
  # keep just date, temperature celcius, salinity psu, and pH columns
  select(Date, `Temperature (ºC)`, `Salinity (PSU)`, pH) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Temperature (ºC)`:pH,
               names_to = "var_name",
               values_to = "var_value") %>%
  mutate(across(var_name, ~factor(., levels=c("Temperature (ºC)","Salinity (PSU)","pH")))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date,
             y = var_value)) +
  facet_wrap(~var_name,
             ncol = 1,
             scales = "free_y",
             strip.position = "left", 
             labeller = as_labeller(c(`Temperature (ºC)` = "Temperature (ºC)", 
                                      `Salinity (PSU)` = "Salinity (PSU)",
                                      pH = "pH"))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.25) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "year",
               date_labels = "%Y") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.placement = "outside")
  
plotHistory

# Save Plot
ggsave(filename = "HachYSI-1x3HistoryPlot.pdf", 
       plot = plotHistory,
       path = "Figures/HachYSI/02_Paper",
       width = 6,
       height = 4)

# environmental variability plot 
# 1x3: Temp C, Salinity (PSU), pH; 2018-2024
plotCurrent <- dfTS %>%
  # use Daily time interval
  filter(`Time Interval` == "Daily") %>%
  filter(Date >= "2018-01-01") %>%
  # keep just date, temperature celcius, salinity psu, and pH columns
  select(Date, `Temperature (ºC)`, `Salinity (PSU)`, pH) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Temperature (ºC)`:pH,
               names_to = "var_name",
               values_to = "var_value") %>%
  mutate(across(var_name, ~factor(., levels=c("Temperature (ºC)","Salinity (PSU)","pH")))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date,
             y = var_value)) +
  facet_wrap(~var_name,
             ncol = 1,
             scales = "free_y",
             strip.position = "left", 
             labeller = as_labeller(c(`Temperature (ºC)` = "Temperature (ºC)", 
                                      `Salinity (PSU)` = "Salinity (PSU)",
                                      pH = "pH"))) +
  geom_point(size = 0.25) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "year",
               date_labels = "%Y") +
  ylab(NULL) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.placement = "outside")
  
plotCurrent

# Save Plot
ggsave(filename = "HachYSI-1x3CurrentPlot.pdf", 
       plot = plotCurrent,
       path = "Figures/HachYSI/02_Paper",
       width = 6,
       height = 4)


# nutrients and water quality time series plot 
# 2x2: Alkalinity, Nitrate MR, Iron, Silica; 2018-2024 
dfNutWatQual_reg <- dfTS %>%
  # use Daily time interval
  filter(`Time Interval` == "Daily") %>%
  filter(Date >= "2018-01-01") %>%
  # keep just date, alkalinity, nitrate mr, iron, and silica columns
  select(Date, `Temperature (ºC)`, `Salinity (PSU)`, pH, `Alkalinity (mg/L CaCO3)`, `Nitrate, Mid-Range (mg/L)`, `Phosphate (mg/L)`, `Silica (mg/L)`, `Iron (mg/L)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Temperature (ºC)`:`Iron (mg/L)`,
               names_to = "var_name",
               values_to = "var_value") %>%
  mutate(across(var_name, ~factor(., levels=c("Temperature (ºC)", "Salinity (PSU)", "pH", "Alkalinity (mg/L CaCO3)", "Nitrate, Mid-Range (mg/L)", "Phosphate (mg/L)", "Silica (mg/L)", "Iron (mg/L)"))))

dfNutWatQual_naomit <- dfTS %>%
  # use Daily time interval
  filter(`Time Interval` == "Monthly") %>%
  filter(Date >= "2018-01-01") %>%
  # keep just date, alkalinity, nitrate mr, iron, and silica columns
  select(Date, `Temperature (ºC)`, `Salinity (PSU)`, pH, `Alkalinity (mg/L CaCO3)`, `Nitrate, Mid-Range (mg/L)`, `Phosphate (mg/L)`, `Silica (mg/L)`, `Iron (mg/L)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Temperature (ºC)`:`Iron (mg/L)`,
               names_to = "var_name",
               values_to = "var_value") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(across(var_name, ~factor(., levels=c("Temperature (ºC)", "Salinity (PSU)", "pH", "Alkalinity (mg/L CaCO3)", "Nitrate, Mid-Range (mg/L)", "Phosphate (mg/L)", "Silica (mg/L)", "Iron (mg/L)"))))

plotNutWatQual_ts <- 
    ggplot(data = dfNutWatQual_reg,
           aes(x = Date,
               y = var_value)) +
    facet_wrap(~var_name,
               ncol = 2,
               scales = "free_y",
               strip.position = "left", 
               labeller = as_labeller(c(`Temperature (ºC)` = "Temperature (ºC)",
                                        `Salinity (PSU)` = "Salinity (PSU)",
                                        pH = "pH", 
                                        `Alkalinity (mg/L CaCO3)` = "Alkalinity (mg/L CaCO3)",
                                        `Nitrate, Mid-Range (mg/L)` = "Nitrate, Mid-Range (mg/L)",
                                        `Phosphate (mg/L)` = "Phosphate (mg/L)", 
                                        `Silica (mg/L)` = "Silica (mg/L)",
                                        `Iron (mg/L)` = "Iron (mg/L)"))) +
    geom_point(color = "lightgray",
               alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = dfNutWatQual_naomit,
              aes(x = Date,
               y = var_value)) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "year",
                 date_labels = "%Y") +
    ylab(NULL) +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_blank(),
          panel.border = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
          strip.background = element_blank(), 
          strip.placement = "outside") 

plotNutWatQual_ts

# Save Plot
ggsave(filename = "HachYSI-NutWatQualPlot-TimeSeries.pdf", 
       plot = plotNutWatQual_ts,
       path = "Figures/HachYSI/02_Paper",
       width = 7,
       height = 7)

row_names <- colnames(matPval)
rownames(matPval) <- row_names

rownames(matRval) <- row_names
Warning: Setting row names on a tibble is deprecated.
# turn both dataframes into matrices
matRval <- as.matrix(matRval)
matPval <- as.matrix(matPval)

# turn NAs into insignificant values
matPval[is.na(matPval)] <- 1.00 
matRval[is.na(matRval)] <- 0.00

# Correlogram with Significance
corrPlot_signif <- ggcorrplot(matRval, 
                              p.mat = matPval,
                              outline.color = "white", 
                              ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_gray(), 
                              colors = c("#6D9EC1", "white", "#E46726"), 
                              lab = TRUE,
                              insig = "blank")
# Save Plot
ggsave(filename = "HachYSI-Correlogram-Significant.pdf", 
       plot = corrPlot_signif,
       path = "Figures/HachYSI/02_Paper",
       width = 7, height = 7)
